C1036.title: Xiangjia Stock Keeper Colluded with Outsiders to Embezzle Over 4 Million Yuan in Eggs
C1036.summary: Four custodians at Hunan Xiangjia Animal Husbandry Co., Ltd. colluded with two external individuals between January 2021 and September 2024, exploiting their positions to embezzle company eggs valued over 4 million yuan by altering outbound data and falsifying records. All six were sentenced for embezzlement.
